Push Nut · Flat Type

Flat Push Nut (FSPN)

A push nut with a flat body in which multiple prongs are arranged facing inward. Unlike a standard push nut (SPN), it can be inserted in either direction with no front/back distinction, which is advantageous for automated assembly lines, and it can be used on both metal and plastic shafts (a 45° prong angle is used for metal shafts, and 10° for plastic shafts). The specification symbol is denoted as FSPN.

フラット プッシュナット (FSPN)

平面推入螺母 (FSPN)

一种本体呈扁平(flat)形状、多个卡爪朝内排列的推入螺母。与普通推入螺母(SPN)不同,它无需区分正反面、任意方向均可插入,有利于自动化装配线使用,并可同时用于金属轴和塑料轴(金属轴采用45°卡爪角度,塑料轴采用10°)。规格代号标记为FSPN。
